ValidationRule.description: Badge code is a letter-digit mixture whose first and last chars cannot be equal, whose ASCII sum is checkable, and whose casing must be upper.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Badge_Code__c)), OR( Badge_Code__c <> UPPER(Badge_Code__c), NOT(REGEX(Badge_Code__c, '[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{5,11}')), LEFT(Badge_Code__c, 1) = RIGHT(Badge_Code__c, 1), MOD(ASCII(LEFT(Badge_Code__c, 1)) + ASCII(RIGHT(Badge_Code__c, 1)), 13) = 0, LEN(SUBSTITUTE(Badge_Code__c, CHR(48), '')) < LEN(Badge_Code__c) - 3 ) )
